data.explanation: Your landlord has sent a formal request to raise your net cold rent (Nettokaltmiete) from €480.00 to €545.00 per month, starting 1 February 2027, citing § 558 BGB (German Civil Code) and three comparable Fulda apartments as justification. German law gives you a period — counted from when you received this letter — to accept, partly accept, or refuse the increase; the app will show this deadline. You may sign and return the enclosed consent form if you agree, or seek advice (e.g. from a tenants' association, Mieterverein) if you want to check whether the comparison rents are accurate before responding. If you neither consent nor object by the deadline shown, the landlord can sue for your consent to the increase before a court.

items.title: Decide on and respond to the rent increase request
items.action: Review the comparison rents cited and decide whether to sign and return the enclosed consent declaration, or seek advice before responding.
items.consequence: If you neither agree nor object by the deadline shown, the landlord may sue you for your consent to the rent increase.
